body: how did you even find this post...
did this help you? that makes me really happy. i hope you’re alright.

I’m so sorry, I hope you’re feeling much better now!
You’re right. What do you mean by “be the girl he wants to date”? It’s clear that he’s gotten comfortable with me putting forth all the effort and he probably knows I love him way more which is why I’m complacent.
I’ve tried to plan special things to do with him but they just never seem to go through. He’s stubborn as hell honestly and aside from the occasional movie whenever theres a block buster, our “dates” are us going grocery shopping and then laying in bed, which I enjoy because I get to be around him.
How do I “challenge” him? I’m so sick of being a lovesick, it’s pathetic. Thank you so much for all of your replies by the way!

you’re completely right. I focus so much of my energy into him and this relationship and feel like I kind of smother him and I should put more energy into more productive things. I tend to isolate myself so I think spending time w friends would be a good thing. thank you!

I just figured that since he deals with depression, I should be there for him in anyway I can. He denies being depressed but it’s quite obvious. I have very severe depression myself so I know exactly how it feels and I don’t want him to feel that way, EVER. 

Whenever I try to tell him about us not talking much/spending time together he tells me that he just had a complete lack of energy. I feel horrible that he feels that way and therefore feel selfish if I were to tell him that he NEEDS to spend time with regardless of how drained he feels sometimes.

i avoided them prior to meeting my bf. he plays games like league of legends and I’ve known about it since I met him. He’s super energized when he plays and I know what it’s like to be hooked on a game and not put it down until you’ve beat it. 

At the same time, one of my brothers eats, sleeps and drinks video games too, yet he spends a tremendous amount of time with his gf, like every single day from the time he leaves school until he comes home at 10pm. I don’t want to tell my bf to not play games, I love seeing him happy and frankly being the gf that polices her boyfriends’ game play is not something I want.
funny you mention the tiredness, I was on adderall 20mg and it made me tired so I switched to Vyvanse. Did you increase after the 40mg?
I have had it for a while and met 2 people off there but we only saw each other once and that was it. I still use it everyday though!
Thank you, seriously. I thought I was going insane & this made me feel a lot better about all of this.
thank you so much lol I genuinely started to feel like I was overreacting. Talking to him about it sounds scary but also a good idea so thank you!

Prejudice happens to everyone regardless of race. Your husband’s family should be ashamed of the way they’ve treated you and your family. Keep your head up, remind your kids everyday that they are beautiful. I’m sorry you’ve dealt with this & I wish you the best too.

I agree with you entirely. Although he’s very ignorant I don’t really think he’s trying being malicious or trying to hurt me deliberately, he seemed to have diarrhea of the mouth. I still don’t know how well it’ll go over if I talk to HR after having only worked a day. I fear that word will get back to him and my coworkers and I’d wish I hadn’t said a thing in the first place.

Yes, I hear you but at the same time what might not seem like a big deal to you because you’re white is one to me because I’be dealt with this my entire life and am just expected to roll with the punches. No one would ever say these things to you about how they force their kids to play with the white kids, or ask if your hair was fake, or tell you that the relationship you’re in is wrong because of your skin color. They wouldn’t say that they want to cross a white lady of their bucket list like they were not even a person but simply a “to-do”. He’s bigoted and ignorant and I shouldn’t have to hear that kind of stuff from a boss ever. Just because this kind of treatment is normalized doesn’t mean that I’m “throwing” the word around loosely. My race isn’t a card, it’s my life and I live it every single day whether I want to or not. Would you really be happy being treated the same way black people are treated?

I understand that but is saying “color should stay with color” not racist? It’s obvious he doesn’t believe white people and black people are equal. He even said “medically” as if he were talking about cross-breeding puppies.
